blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Mission total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Mission West fell from 12 in June to 5 in September, and 2 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 2.2% of Mission’s 231 houses listed.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Mission West?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 5 houses listed in Mission West. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Mission West a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Mission West had a sales ratio of 20% on only 5 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Mission West from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 2 houses sold in Mission West over those 4 months, out of 124 in all of Mission.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Mission West?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
